topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't get this off my mind, the things we found, the notes and trinkets, all so young and hopeful. It’s like staring at an old photo, but the faces aren’t the worst part. It’s how they’re smiling, how the world seemed so wide and bright. Now, I don’t know if it’s just me, but the sky feels a bit smaller, don’t you think? We were going to save the world, remember? Instead, we’re just trying to hold on to what we’ve got. I keep thinking about those hopes, wondering where they went, if they’re even around to be found. It’s like the time capsule is a reminder of all the things we lost without even noticing.
